description: This file manages SDK binary media file handling tools, including installation, extraction, and execution of external binaries such as ffprobe, ffmpeg, ipfs, and fpcalc, with version management and integrity checks.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs binary tools for content extraction and metadata handling, including ffprobe, ffmpeg, ipfs, and fpcalc, using concurrent execution.

methods.name: system_tag
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current system and architecture, e.g., 'linux-64'.

methods.name: is_installed
methods.description: Checks if a given binary file exists and is executable.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts downloaded archive files, handling zip and tar.gz formats, and removes the archive after extraction.

methods.name: ipfs_download_url
methods.description: Returns the system-dependent URL for downloading IPFS binaries.

methods.name: ipfs_bin
methods.description: Returns the local path to the IPFS executable.

methods.name: ipfs_download
methods.description: Downloads the IPFS binary archive, returning the file path.

methods.name: ipfs_install
methods.description: Installs IPFS CLI tool, initializes the repo, and returns the executable path.

methods.name: ipfs_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves the installed IPFS version or indicates if not installed.

methods.name: run_ipfs
methods.description: Runs an IPFS command with specified arguments, installing IPFS if necessary.

methods.name: fpcalc_bin
methods.description: Returns the local path to the fpcalc executable.

methods.name: fpcalc_is_installed
methods.description: Checks if fpcalc is installed and executable.

methods.name: fpcalc_download_url
methods.description: Returns the system-dependent URL for downloading fpcalc.

methods.name: fpcalc_download
methods.description: Downloads the fpcalc archive, returning the file path.

methods.name: fpcalc_extract
methods.description: Extracts the fpcalc executable from the archive.

methods.name: fpcalc_install
methods.description: Installs fpcalc and returns the executable path.

methods.name: fpcalc_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves the installed fpcalc version.

methods.name: run_fpcalc
methods.description: Runs an fpcalc command with specified arguments, installing fpcalc if necessary.

methods.name: ffprobe_download_url
methods.description: Returns the system-dependent URL for downloading ffprobe.

methods.name: ffprobe_bin
methods.description: Returns the local path to the ffprobe executable.

methods.name: ffprobe_download
methods.description: Downloads the ffprobe archive, returning the file path.

methods.name: ffprobe_extract
methods.description: Extracts ffprobe from the archive.

methods.name: ffprobe_install
methods.description: Installs ffprobe and returns the executable path.

methods.name: ffprobe_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the installed ffprobe.

methods.name: run_ffprobe
methods.description: Runs an ffprobe command with specified arguments, installing ffprobe if necessary.

methods.name: ffmpeg_download_url
methods.description: Returns the system-dependent URL for downloading ffmpeg.

methods.name: ffmpeg_bin
methods.description: Returns the local path to the ffmpeg executable.

methods.name: ffmpeg_download
methods.description: Downloads the ffmpeg archive, returning the file path.

methods.name: ffmpeg_extract
methods.description: Extracts ffmpeg from the archive.

methods.name: ffmpeg_install
methods.description: Installs ffmpeg and returns the executable path.

methods.name: ffmpeg_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the installed ffmpeg.

methods.name: run_ffmpeg
methods.description: Runs an ffmpeg command with specified arguments, installing ffmpeg if necessary.

methods.name: download_file
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL, verifies its integrity with checksum, and returns the file path.
